Indian Athletes Win Medals at World Athletics U20 Championships

Indian athletes Basant Kumar and Shahnawaz secured medals at the World Athletics U20 Championships. Basant Kumar won a silver medal in the high jump, becoming the first Indian to achieve this in the event. Shahnawaz won a bronze medal in the long jump. Both athletes achieved historic feats for India in their respective disciplines.
